resources.string: AdVault blocks advertising and tracking domains for all your apps and games, at the DNS level.
Turn on protection once and play without most interstitial, banner and video ads.
A VPN that stays on your phone
Android will ask you to allow a VPN connection. AdVault uses it only to see DNS lookups on this device — there is no remote server and nothing leaves your device through AdVault.
No HTTPS interception, no certificates, no tracking. Logs stay local and can be cleared any time.
Some ads come from the same servers as the content and cannot be blocked by DNS.
Rewarded ads can\'t be faked: blocking them usually means their rewards are unavailable. You can allow them per game in the Reward Assistant.
Only one VPN can run at a time, and Android Private DNS can bypass filtering.
